name: Lyo.Authorization
tagline: Resource grants. A check asks whether a subject may perform an action on a resource.
description: A grant is a subject, an action, a resource type, an optional resource id, and an optional tenant. It does not sign anyone in and it does not parse tokens. A null resource id covers every id of that type. A set id matches only that id. The same split applies to tenant. There are no deny rows.
features: **Expired at utc now is denied.** An expired row still occupies the active key until it is revoked. Save supersedes an expired row and inserts a new one.
**Checks are not audited.** Saves, revokes, and supersedes are. A throwing audit recorder does not fail the save.
